description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Editor, which implements a commit driver for integrating Git with Subversion. It manages diffs between trees, applies changes to a Subversion repository, and provides functions for file and directory operations, handling properties, and driving SVN delta editing. It is a core component facilitating 'git svn' functionality.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: A Perl module that implements a commit driver for 'git svn' operations, enabling synchronization of git trees with a Subversion repository by generating and applying diffs, managing repository paths, properties, and file states.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the editor with options, setting up properties, generating diffs, and preparing the environment for commit operations.

methods.name: generate_diff
methods.description: Creates a diff between two trees, considering copy similarities, and returns a list of modifications to apply.

methods.name: check_diff_paths
methods.description: Checks the types of paths involved in the diff, caching their statuses.

methods.name: split_path
methods.description: Splits a path into directory and filename components.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository-specific path, respecting pathname encoding.

methods.name: url_path
methods.description: Constructs the URL path for a given repository relative path.

methods.name: rmdirs
methods.description: Removes directories that have been marked for deletion based on the diff.

methods.name: open_or_add_dir
methods.description: Opens an existing directory or adds a new one based on its type.

methods.name: ensure_path
methods.description: Ensures that the full path exists in the repository, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: glob2pat
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern into a regular expression.

methods.name: check_autoprop
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches a pattern and applies auto properties if so.

methods.name: apply_autoprops
methods.description: Applies auto properties to a file based on configuration.

methods.name: check_attr
methods.description: Checks SVN attributes for a file, e.g., svn properties.

methods.name: apply_manualprops
methods.description: Applies manual properties to a file based on SVN attributes.

methods.name: A
methods.description: Handles addition of a new file in the diff.

methods.name: C
methods.description: Handles copying (renaming) a file in the diff.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory from the repository.

methods.name: R
methods.description: Handles renaming or moving a file.

methods.name: M
methods.description: Handles modification of a file.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Handles toggling a symlink property.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Changes a file property.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Changes a directory property.

methods.name: _chg_file_get_blob
methods.description: Retrieves the blob (content) of a file, generating a temp file and checksum.

methods.name: chg_file
methods.description: Handles changes in file content and properties.

methods.name: D
methods.description: Deletes a file in the diff.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the edit process, closing open directories.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the current edit operation.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up resources on object destruction.

methods.name: apply_diff
methods.description: Main method to apply the generated diff modifications to the repository, executing all changes in order.
